description: This file defines a FastAPI server with endpoints for storing trace data, generating bugfix merge requests, and creating test coverage, utilizing various imported utilities and data models.

classes.name: SerializedObject
classes.description: Represents a serialized Python object with its type and JSON data.

classes.name: Arguments
classes.description: Holds positional and keyword arguments for function calls.

classes.name: ExceptionInfo
classes.description: Contains details about an exception, including type, value, and traceback.

classes.name: BaseExecutionTraceItem
classes.description: Base class for different types of execution trace items, capturing common fields.

classes.name: CallExecutionTraceItem
classes.description: Represents a function call event with arguments and return value.

classes.name: ExceptionExecutionTraceItem
classes.description: Represents an exception event with exception details.

classes.name: ReturnExecutionTraceItem
classes.description: Represents a function return event with return value.

classes.name: TraceData
classes.description: Main data model for trace information, including invocation details and execution trace.

methods.name: parse_execution_trace
methods.description: Validator to parse and convert raw trace data into appropriate trace item objects.

methods.name: store_trace_log
methods.description: API endpoint to store a new trace log in Redis.

methods.name: generate_bugfix_mr
methods.description: API endpoint to trigger bugfix merge request generation.

methods.name: generate_test_coverage
methods.description: API endpoint to initiate test coverage creation based on trace data.
